description: Source code for an internal MQTT client implementation within the AWS IoT Python SDK, including classes for client status management, asynchronous MQTT client operations, and callback handling.

classes.name: ClientStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of various client connection states.

classes.name: ClientStatusContainer
classes.description: Container class to manage and update the client's connection status.

classes.name: InternalAsyncMqttClient
classes.description: Asynchronous MQTT client handling connection, messaging, and callback management.

methods.name: set_cert_credentials_provider
methods.description: Configures TLS certificates and ciphers for secure MQTT connection.

methods.name: set_iam_credentials_provider
methods.description: Sets IAM credentials for authentication.

methods.name: set_endpoint_provider
methods.description: Sets the endpoint provider for server connection details.

methods.name: configure_last_will
methods.description: Configures the Last Will and Testament message.

methods.name: configure_alpn_protocols
methods.description: Configures ALPN protocols for the connection.

methods.name: clear_last_will
methods.description: Clears the Last Will message.

methods.name: set_username_password
methods.description: Sets username and password for authentication.

methods.name: set_socket_factory
methods.description: Sets a custom socket factory.

methods.name: configure_reconnect_back_off
methods.description: Configures reconnect backoff timing parameters.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to MQTT broker and starts network loop.

methods.name: start_background_network_io
methods.description: Starts the background network I/O thread.

methods.name: stop_background_network_io
methods.description: Stops the background network I/O thread.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from MQTT broker and updates callbacks.

methods.name: _create_combined_on_connect_callback
methods.description: Creates a callback for successful connection events.

methods.name: _create_combined_on_disconnect_callback
methods.description: Creates a callback for disconnect events.

methods.name: _create_converted_on_message_callback
methods.description: Creates a callback for message reception events.

methods.name: on_online
methods.description: Placeholder for online notification.

methods.name: on_offline
methods.description: Placeholder for offline notification.

methods.name: on_message
methods.description: Placeholder for message reception notification.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a topic, optionally with an acknowledgment callback.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a topic with a specified QoS, optionally with an acknowledgment callback.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a topic, optionally with an acknowledgment callback.

methods.name: register_internal_event_callbacks
methods.description: Registers internal event callbacks for MQTT events.

methods.name: unregister_internal_event_callbacks
methods.description: Unregisters internal event callbacks.

methods.name: invoke_event_callback
methods.description: Invokes a registered callback for a given message ID.

methods.name: remove_event_callback
methods.description: Removes a callback for a specific message ID.

methods.name: clean_up_event_callbacks
methods.description: Clears all registered event callbacks.

methods.name: get_event_callback_map
methods.description: Returns the current map of message IDs to callbacks.
